lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform with slight compression observed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most three line segments are truncated, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral margin of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3-4 distinct high-contrast white spots located on the lateral posterior haunch above the stifle.

other_distinctive_markers: Dorsal white mane/crest extending along the spinal ridge and white chevron facial markings on the muzzle bridge.
